rotary.verdict: CREDIBLE for Track F: both rings already carry a stationary-to-rotating fluid-coupling cartridge and contactless power/data channels at the hub (rotor_interface, OD-013 OPEN). The hub unit reaches each ring through that ring's own coupling. Seven units pass 9 of 10 cases; the one failure is three concurrent losses (ring A, one B unit and the hub unit). Eight units (4 + 4) pass all 10 for +1.2 t but leave no unit that can serve either ring. Owner rule DR5-06: seven, because the hub unit can credibly serve both rings.

radiators.rule: F1 picks the rejection temperature that frees the most HOT length while the reactor stays at or below the research thermal power

ledger.note: P_fusion = P_jet + P_absorbed + P_other; the pickup takes P_e/eta from the jet (thrust falls by half that share at constant mass flow); the loss is deposited in the pickup winding inside the existing nozzle structure and carried by the H6a loop to the HOT radiators (1800 K): a real sink, inside the 20 % rule only while it fits the HOT headroom

startup.rule: direct conversion produces power only while the drive burns: ignition, preheat and restart come from the pulse bank, the main battery and L2 (continuous generation and stored pulse energy are separate)
startup.steady: DC feeds L1 after ignition; the pulse bank recharges from DC

physics.principle: Faraday induction (flux change in a pickup winding as the burn plasma expands against the nozzle field)
physics.precedent: Daedalus induction loop (BIS 1978); pulsed inductive recovery in magneto-inertial fusion experiments
physics.limit: steady flow induces no EMF: needs a pulsed or modulated exhaust
large grid area in the beam; grid erosion

physics.precedent: Momota et al. for D-3He 14.7 MeV protons, ~60-70 % calculated

problems.text: Hot-loop walls: 1,833 t nominal on the R5-A length; Mo-Re walls exceed their temperature limit at the nominal inlet.
L1 thermal conversion rejects 39 MW at 900 K; a 900 K section needs 8.3 m of hot length that the 20 % rule no longer has after R5-A.
He-3 stage: OpenMC side scatter adds ~53 W (C load) to the 118 W leak lift (+45 %); the installed cryocooler rating and final shielding stay OPEN (DR5-08).

Deep penetration not verified: MAGIC weight windows are verified against exp(-Sigma t) only to 20 cm of LiH-W (40 cm within statistics); the 2.54 m shadow-shield transmission needs adjoint (CADIS) variance reduction before any through-shield number is used.
F0: HOT headroom under the 20 % rule is 58 MW; a reactive defense engagement in a burn (heat pumps + DC loss) does not fit. F1 (FT-03) frees 1,029 MW.
Propellant does not fit the historical tank farm in any coupled case; the farm must grow (Track F geometry below).
FT-04 needs a pulsed or modulated exhaust; the production drive repetition rate is OPEN in canon.
Rotary utility couplings (air, water, gas) at both ring hubs are not designed (OD-013); the 7-unit ECLSS depends on them.
Strategy C part-load efficiency raises L2 waste above the linear share; the cross-strapped sections still close (see 4.3).
OpenMC: surrogate source, simplified structure, no dose; deep-penetration convergence through the shadow shield reported with weight windows (rad6).

decisions.q: Freeze F1 as the Track F working reference (8.2 kt class), with F0 and Track R as comparisons?
FT-03 approved (owner 07:03Z): confirm the 950 K L2 reject temperature chosen for F1 (most HOT length freed at no more reactor power than Track R)?
Track F tank farm: lengthen the 13 tanks forward (option A) in a fictional geometry variant?
Accept 7 ECLSS units with the hub unit served through each ring's rotary coupling (P6-07 stays open)?
Rate the Track F DC L1 at 100 MWe (reactive defense in a burn) only with F1, 20 MWe with F0?
Publish the Phase VI R/F comparison on the website after review (no deployment until approved)?

radiation.status: 3-D TRANSPORT-INFORMED, Track R (surrogate source, simplified structure); not validated; no dose or crew-safety claim

source_provenance.spectrum: Phase IV S1: OpenMC k-eigenvalue leakage spectrum of a simplified UN / Li / Mo surrogate core (not a design)
source_provenance.placement: three isotropic point sources at the L2 unit centres (x -84, r 2.9)
source_provenance.normalisation: per fission in each unit; x fission rate of a 750 K unit at full power downstream

summary.finding: All tanks at C load: 76 W of nuclear heating, 100 % from side scatter outside the shadow cone (Phase V: ~161 W at the 700 K bulkhead station with the Phase V tally set; the cause of the difference is not isolated). The through-shield components are below 0.001 W, but the benchmark ladder shows the weight windows are NOT verified beyond 20 cm (40 cm: 1.3x at ±41 %, 60 cm: 9x high, 100 cm: 17x low against exp(-Sigma t), 254 cm: no score), so the 2.54 m transmission is not a credible number yet: it needs adjoint-based variance reduction (CADIS/FW-CADIS). Statistical: the worst single tank tally is ±100 %. Transport-informed on a surrogate source; shielding, crew dose and the installed cryocooler rating stay OPEN (DR5-08).

benchmark.note: uncollided ratio within 10 % at <10 % statistics; weight-window runs beyond that disagree with the analytic value
